changes: Reserve space for the Dashboard subscription and adjacent content on cold visits and when returning to cached data.
Keep subscription purchase and renewal actions disabled until fresh status and purchase options are available after reconnecting or retrying.
Keep ticket lists and the reply field in place during loading, and serve Manrope from the Cabinet assets.
Preload the profile photo for the signed-in Telegram identity and keep it isolated when switching accounts.
Show a text recommendation in the VPN connection guide.

limitations.summary: Classic purchase still requires manual confirmation after balance top-up.
Physical Telegram Mini App and native client coverage is unverified for this release.
External panel app configuration and merchant sandbox checkout/recurring flows were not part of the verified browser scope.
The unused createEmail wrapper is unchanged; current UI uses the supported combined endpoint.
A delayed subscriptions list can temporarily expose a renewal action for an active daily tariff. Reproduced on the previous stable and this candidate.
